attackers_goals: An adversary may leverage local groups discovery to identify privileged groups and escalate privileges.
description: A user enumerated local groups via RPC.
investigative_actions: Determine the user, hostname, and process that performed the group enumeration. Inspect process, command-line arguments or scripts used. Check for any privilege escalation or lateral movement attempts from the source system. Check if the tool used to enumerate the local groups is a known or an approved tool. Review the logs for suspicious activity from the same host or user.
name: Local group enumeration via RPC
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
